questions.text: A building is at a distance of 108 feet from point A on the ground. The angle of elevation of the top of the building from point A is θ. If tan θ = 4/3, then find the height (in feet) of the building.

options.text: Two successive discounts of 7% and 7% Section : General Intelligence and Reasoning
